_provenance:
DERIVED, not live-captured (2026-06-22). chestertons.co.uk is a Cloudflare-gated Next.js SPA: a desktop-UA curl of the property-to-rent path returns the Cloudflare-challenged HTML shell with ZERO '.pegasus-property-card' markup (cards are JS-rendered), so a network-free real capture is impossible without a browser. These card dicts are DERIVED from (a) the documented Chestertons card textContent format at chestertons_spider.py:481 ('Long Let
Address
beds
baths
receptions
sqft
2
£price
(pcm)
Fees apply'), (b) the harvest evaluate() shape {href,address,letType,textContent} at chestertons_spider.py:337-361, and (c) the committed sale-mode card fixture tests/fixtures/for_sale/chestertons_card_data_for_sale.json (same textContent layout, sale mode).
_warning: These tuples LOCK the CURRENT line-POSITION bed heuristic (nums[0]/nums[1] = the FIRST two \b\d\b tokens after the address line). Unlike KnightFrank (nums[-3]/nums[-2], which reaches backward into the price), Chestertons takes the first digits immediately after the address (beds/baths precede sqft+price), so these derived cards happen to parse beds/baths CORRECTLY. The assertions in TestChestertonsParsing pin these exact values to catch any drift in the heuristic or the card shape.
